config.label: A funded channel key in the form channelId:channelSecret
config.description: A funded channel key in the form channelId:channelSecret. Open + fund a channel once at https://inference.bsvkey.com. Optional (can be passed per call).

config.label: Gateway base URL
config.description: Gateway base URL. Defaults to https://inference.bsvkey.com/v1; override to point at a self-hosted deployment.

config.label: A funded BSV private key (WIF) used by the x402_infer tool to pay per call in BSV (no channel)
config.description: A funded BSV private key (WIF) used by the x402_infer tool to pay per call in BSV (no channel). Signing is local; the key never leaves the process. Optional (can be passed per call).

config.label: The amount you funded your channel with on-chain
config.description: The amount you funded your channel with on-chain. When set, usage receipts are verified against this instead of the broker-signed fundedSats. Optional (can be passed per call as fundedSats).

config.label: Path to a JSON file where per-channel receipt continuity (seq + running totals) is persisted, so replays are caught across restarts
config.description: Path to a JSON file where per-channel receipt continuity (seq + running totals) is persisted, so replays are caught across restarts. Optional; in-memory only if unset.
